decisions.statement: An answer opening with yes is a yes.
An answer whose last line is yes alone is a yes to a caller reading the last line.
A caller reading the last line takes a line holding anything besides yes as no.
Everything that is no letter is passed over before the opening is read.
An answer is read whatever case the answer is written in.
Nothing here says what a yes means to the caller.

definition: how a yes or no answer from a model is read
